we have built a hybrid question answering system that can be instantiated in multiple enterprise domains.
we have designed a hybrid model for a general purpose question-answering system that can be deployed across multiple domains.

the design and implementation of an automated question answering system that can be instantiated across multiple domains.
the development of an enterprise wide question answering system that is scalable and can be deployed across multiple products.

the following aspects: 1) building an enterprise wide cognitive platform for IT support, 2) building an enterprise level question answering system for the IT support domain and 3) building a hybrid model for answering questions in the support domain.
